patch.role: Space-only trim: restores A for space-padded adjacency lines.

inputs.expose_tab_padding: adjacency line padded with a tab: the node name keeps it

rationale: parse_adjlist() trims each adjacency line before splitting it into node names. The patch restores trimming for spaces only; a tab-padded line keeps the tab inside the first node name, which is the exposing witness.
